title: Primary math: measurement and units
description: Four lessons building unit sense: length, mass, time conversions and choosing sensible units, with real-world transfer.
assumptions: Metric units with whole-number conversions (1 m = 100 cm, 1 kg = 1000 g, 1 h = 60 min). No apparatus needed.
stage1goal: Build conversion rules from unit size.
stage2goal: Choose units and estimate in real situations.
length-units.title: Length: metres and centimetres
length-units.reading: 1 m = 100 cm. Bigger unit means fewer of them: 3 m = 300 cm; 250 cm = 2 m 50 cm.
length-units.worked.prompt: Why does 3 m become 300 cm, not 30 cm?
length-units.worked.hint: How many cm in one m?
length-units.independent.a.label: 2 m 50 cm
length-units.independent.b.label: 25 m
mass-units.title: Mass: kilograms and grams
mass-units.reading: 1 kg = 1000 g. A bag of 2 kg weighs 2000 g; 1500 g is 1 kg 500 g.
mass-units.worked.prompt: Why is 2 kg equal to 2000 g?
mass-units.worked.hint: How many g in one kg?
mass-units.independent.a.label: 15 kg
mass-units.independent.b.label: 1 kg 500 g
time-units.title: Time: hours and minutes
time-units.goal: Convert hours and minutes and compute elapsed time.
time-units.reading: 1 h = 60 min (not 100!). 2 h = 120 min; 90 min = 1 h 30 min.
time-units.struggle: Without computing, explain why 90 minutes is 1 hour 30 minutes and not 1 hour 90 minutes.
time-units.worked.fb: An hour is defined as 60 minutes.
time-units.transfer-elapsed.prompt: A film starts at 14:00 and runs 90 min. What minute-of-hour does it end (15:?)?
choose-units.title: Choose sensible units
choose-units.goal: Pick appropriate units and estimate real quantities.
choose-units.reading: Unit sense: a pencil is ~15 cm not 15 m; a apple ~150 g not 150 kg; a class ~40 min not 40 h.
choose-units.worked.prompt: Why is a pencil measured in cm, not m?
choose-units.worked.fb: A pencil is much shorter than a metre.
choose-units.worked.content: Pencil ~15 cm; metre is too big a unit.
choose-units.independent.a.label: 150 g
choose-units.independent.b.label: 150 kg
choose-units.transfer-estimate.a.label: cm
choose-units.transfer-estimate.b.label: m
choose-units.c1.a.label: min
choose-units.c1.b.label: h
choose-units.c2.a.label: L
choose-units.c2.b.label: mL
